title: Noordveld Spark: Parts Intelligence and agentic e-commerce in one conversation
disclaimer: Demonstration data. Not real operational data.

scenes.title: Service due.
scenes.vo: A compact wheel loader is due for service. Its owner needs an air filter, and doesn't have the part number.

scenes.title: One conversation.
scenes.vo: Spark puts Parts Intelligence and ordering in one conversation. Start with the machine, the part or the job at hand.

scenes.title: Describe the need.
scenes.vo: Ask for an air filter for the NV-3200, preferably in stock. Spark checks fitment, catalogue status and stock, and recommends one part: it fits, it is verified, and it is in stock. It also says what it left out, and why.

scenes.title: See how it connects.
scenes.vo: Ask to see it as a graph. Parts Intelligence draws the recorded relationships: the three machines it fits, its two suppliers, and the six depots that hold it. Every link is marked as source data, or synthetic demo data.

scenes.title:
Say it.
Spark fills the order.
scenes.vo: Then say: order it. Spark fills the order from the saved profile, with the delivery site, dealer and contact, and proposes the fastest recorded delivery.

scenes.title:
Compare.
Then choose.
scenes.vo: Want a different delivery? Spark compares the recorded options by depot, arrival estimate and total cost, best match first. Standard road arrives a day later, for less.

scenes.title:
You confirm.
Then it's ordered.
scenes.vo: Every change updates the same order. The review shows the part, delivery, dealer, contact and total, excluding VAT. Nothing is ordered until you press Place order.

scenes.title: Parts Intelligence and ordering, in one conversation.
scenes.vo: Find it. See how it connects. Order it, on your terms. Spark, at Noordveld.
